name: Proxy_b7e1
fix_description: In function 0x9b3e9b92, path B (var5 != 0) calculates mint amount based on balanceOf(address(this)) which includes tokens from previous deposits via path A. Attacker deposits via path A first (no mint), then calls path B which mints based on total contract balance (both deposits combined). Fix by using the current call amount parameter for mint calculation instead of the contract total balance.
difficulty_reasoning: The exploit is only a few external calls, but it is not an obvious generic bug pattern: the attacker crafts low-level calldata with protocol-specific packed parameters and relies on understanding the target proxy/order logic to drain funds. Writing this PoC would likely require reading the contract internals and reverse-engineering those magic values, putting it above easy but below a truly complex multi-protocol attack.
